besluite.rede: 'Dit was swaar om te onthou' is natural spoken Afrikaans in a story and carries the burden of months of medicine as well as the remembering; 'moeilik' narrows it to the remembering only and spends the story's voice.

'Loop' is the ordinary Afrikaans idiom for how a disease passes from person to person, and the original reads well. This sentence carries the checked claim on how TB spreads, so a sideways word swap is not worth the risk.

'Nagaan' (check) and 'ondersoek' (examine) are not the same action: the swap changes what the clinic is said to do with a two-week cough, and 'nagaan' fits the next sentence, 'Hulle kyk liewer te vroeg as te laat'.
'Klaar geluister' is natural Afrikaans and says exactly that she heard Palesa out first; the proposal is longer and only reads differently.
